name: nf_initiatives_columns
description: Per-column analyzer assignments for the nf-initiatives SearchIndex (syn75081635, source syn24189696). Roles: IDENTIFIER for id-like fields (abbreviations, URLs, hierarchical paths — preserve punctuation, no stemming); nf_scientific_synonyms for free-text scientific/discovery fields (stemming + NF synonym expansion at search time); KEYWORD for clean categorical/facet fields. The initiative column (each row's own name/title) and the image file handle fall through to the config defaultAnalyzer (STANDARD). Columns absent from the index are silently skipped at build time.
